statement: A business term or ontology concept is not a dimension member.
An analytical entity role is not business identity authority.
Observation, event, fact, record and snapshot must not collapse.
A storage row is not analytical grain.
A population definition is not an incidental query filter.
A dimension is not merely a physical column.
A dimension member is not its display label.
A hierarchy is not generic ordering or a convenient UI tree.
Measure, metric, KPI, target, benchmark and observation remain distinct.
A governed metric is not a dashboard tile or chart series.
A target or threshold is not an observed value or forecast.
A benchmark does not authorize acceptance or action.
Formula text/AST is not a formula definition, binding or evaluation.
A formula definition with free references is not executable until exact binding succeeds.
Binding success is not evaluation success or result correctness.
Equal function names across providers do not imply equal semantics.
Pure formula evaluation must not hide clock, registry, data, randomness, policy or network effects.
Null, absent, unknown, suppressed, not-applicable, empty and zero remain distinct.
Empty population and nonempty population with all values missing must not collapse.
A unit label is not an editioned unit identity or conversion proof.
Unit conversion and currency valuation remain distinct.
A currency code does not supply rate source, time, direction or rounding.
Ratio of sums, sum of ratios and average of ratios are generally distinct.
A zero denominator must not silently become zero, infinity or missing.
Event, valid, recording, publication and query time remain distinct.
Calendar/fiscal period and time zone are independently editioned.
Freshness, completeness, validity and finality remain distinct.
A correction/supersession must not rewrite historical observation identity.
Additivity and decomposability remain independent properties.
Aggregate result and sufficient merge state are not interchangeable.
Roll-up is not universally SUM.
Structural query validity does not prove semantic summarizability.
Entity relation existence does not authorize an analytical join.
Join cardinality semantics are not row-count estimates.
Many-to-many joins are not fanout-safe without allocation, compatible preaggregation, valid deduplication or refusal.
Deduplication is not a universal remedy for fanout.
A semantic query is not SQL text.
Matching SQL text is neither necessary nor sufficient for semantic cache equivalence.
Materialization identity, cache entry and metric observation remain distinct.
A query result is not presentation state or a report artifact.
Domain question, data/task abstraction, visual encoding and rendering algorithm are distinct validation layers.
Mapping a field to a visual channel cannot define metric meaning.
A syntactically valid chart is not evidence of truthful or effective communication.
Scale transform and display range do not mutate underlying semantic values.
An axis label does not establish unit, grain, population or time semantics.
Color assignment is not category identity and color alone cannot carry essential meaning.
Visual proximity or layout does not create semantic grouping.
An analytical table model is not the source dataset or query result identity.
Pivoting is not automatically valid aggregation or summarization.
Interaction state does not mutate source facts or metric definitions.
Visual selection, semantic filter and source predicate remain distinct.
Drill navigation does not prove hierarchy validity or authorization.
A view session and its interaction history are not a query result.
Dashboard, report, widget, chart, table and snapshot remain distinct artifacts.
A live view and immutable report snapshot cannot share a completeness claim.
Approval, publication, disclosure, export and delivery are distinct authorities/effects.
Alert condition evaluation and notification delivery remain distinct.
Alert pending, firing, resolved, silenced and acknowledged states must not collapse.
A subscription schedule is not a delivery attempt, acknowledgement or business outcome.
Exported bytes do not imply governed, continuing or revocable access.
Export encoding and delivery are separate failure/evidence boundaries.
An embedded guest surface does not inherit host identity, policy or business authority implicitly.
Offline cache freshness does not establish source finality or entitlement continuation.
Accessibility semantics are not styling, color theme or alternate text alone.
WCAG conformance does not by itself prove equivalent analytical task performance.
A chart description is not the underlying data, interaction model or evidence.
Localization and bidi formatting must not change semantic values.
Uncertainty is not an optional decorative channel.
Measurement/statistical uncertainty, visual perception and decision risk remain distinct.
Renderer success does not prove semantic, perceptual or accessibility conformance.
A fallback is acceptable only with proven semantic and task equivalence or explicit degradation receipt.
Provenance and replay evidence do not prove metric correctness or decision fitness.
An analytical finding, dashboard insight or alert is not authority to decide or act.
AI or agents may propose formulas/charts/narratives but cannot infer hidden grain, choose defaults, waive evidence or authorize effects.
